title: Core spine hard-coupled to ScriptedDirector, defeating the ADR-7 seam
evidence:
run_state.gd:23  var director: ScriptedDirector = null
crisis_engine.gd:24  			  era_id: int, director: ScriptedDirector) -> CrisisReport:
crisis_engine.gd:30  		report.forecast = director.forecast_for_era(era_id, tick)
crisis_director.gd:16  func plan_pressure(_topology: TopologySnapshot, _era_id: int, _tick: int,  (the ONLY method on the base; forecast_for_ema is absent)
detail: RunState.director and CrisisEngine's param are typed to the concrete ScriptedDirector, and CrisisEngine calls forecast_for_era which is NOT on the CrisisDirector base. ADR-7/§10.4's 'swapping impls is config' fails — a V2 director needs Core signature edits.
recommended_fix: Type RunState.director and the CrisisEngine param as the CrisisDirector base; promote forecast_for_era onto the base interface (or expose forecast via plan_pressure's PressurePlan) so Core depends only on the seam.

title: Determinism fingerprint omits in-flight packet state (AC-E10 coverage gap)
evidence:
sim_snapshot.gd docstring: ## from the same (seed, action_log) MUST produce identical fingerprints (AC-E10).
sim_snapshot.gd:43  d["in_flight"] = in_flight   (a COUNT only)
(grep of sim_snapshot.gd for route|edge_idx|progress_units returns NO matches — per-packet logical state is absent from the snapshot entirely)
detail: to_fingerprint captures only an in-flight count plus cumulative totals/topology; per-packet route/edge_idx/progress (the iteration-order-sensitive state AC-E10 exists to catch) are not projected, so a routing-level non-determinism could pass the byte-identical check.
recommended_fix: Project in-flight packets (id, route pipe-ids, edge_idx, progress_units, lane) into the fingerprint, sorted by id, so the determinism-equality test covers packet routing state, not just aggregate counts.

title: QoS priority-emphasis preset is a hardcoded literal, not catalog data
evidence:
packet_flow.gd:153  	if pipe.priority_class == &"streaming" or pipe.priority_class == &"email":
packet_flow.gd:154  		weights = Vector3i(4, 1, 1)
(called from the per-tick hot path at packet_flow.gd:211)
detail: The prioritized-pipe weight preset Vector3i(4,1,1) is a live tuning ratio in the QoS hot path, restated as code rather than living in game/data/ — a numbers-single-source (project-context) + ADR-5 break. Acceptable prototype debt; flagging per the lens.
recommended_fix: Add a priority_lane_weights Vector3i field to BalanceData + balance.json and read balance.priority_lane_weights in _pipe_lane_caps, mirroring how default_lane_weights is already data-driven.
